scope_summary.value: Complete HVAC system replacement for the Lynchburg Readiness Center, including removal and replacement of all rooftop HVAC units per CPSM life cycle cost analysis, ductwork analysis and replacement/cleaning, piping analysis and replacement/cleaning, installation of infectious disease prevention components (bipolar ionization, high-efficiency filtration, UV lighting, cold fusion), upgrade of Building Automation System (BAS) with humidity/temperature controls, HVAC zoning upgrades, and associated minor electrical and architectural work.
scope_summary.source: Request for Fee Proposal (Lynchburg).pdf, Section II
scope_summary.quote:
Complete HVAC system replacement to include:
• Removal and replacement of all units in accordance with CPSM life cycle cost analysis
• Analyzation of existing duct work, removal and replacement or extensive cleaning, as necessary
• Analyzation of existing piping, removal and replacement or extensive cleaning, as necessary
• Installation of system components designed to prevent spread of infectious diseases, to include bipolar ionization, high efficiency filtration, UV lighting, visible lighting, cold fusion, and other emergent technologies
• Upgrade of building Automation System to include humidity and temperature controls
• Zoning of HVAC to reduce potential migration of airborne particles
• Minor associated electrical and architectural work, as required

existing_electrical_system.value: 800A, 208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire main distribution panel (MDP) in Mechanical Room A27. Additional 208Y/120V, 3-phase panelboards throughout facility: Panel LA, PB, PBR (Mech Room A27), Panel PR (Corridor A29), Panel PK (Storage A44/kitchen area), Panel LB (Corridor A3).
existing_electrical_system.source: RRMM Field Report-Lynchburg RC.docx, ELECTRICAL OBSERVATIONS
existing_electrical_system.quote: The main electrical service entrance distribution panel was located in the mechanical room A27. The main service entrance panel "MDP" is an 800A, 800A M.C.B., 208Y/120V, 3 phase, 4 wire service.

electrical_scope.value: Remove electrical devices, wiring, and conduit back to existing panels to facilitate HVAC equipment replacement; temporarily support existing lighting fixtures during ductwork removal; install new circuits for new HVAC equipment; reinstall existing lighting fixtures in ceiling systems.
electrical_scope.source: RRMM Field Report-Lynchburg RC.docx, ELECTRICAL OBSERVATIONS item 4
electrical_scope.quote: The electrical scope of the project is to support the replacement of the existing roof top mounted HVAC equipment and any of its associated equipment electrically. This will entail the removal of any and all electrical devices, wiring and conduit back to the existing panel and temporarily supporting existing lighting fixtures throughout the interior spaces of the facility to facilitate the removal of any existing ductwork to be removed and replaced. It will also include the installation of new circuits to serve the new HVAC equipment and the reinstallation of the existing lighting fixtures in the ceiling systems in each space that the ceiling was taken down.
